name: University of Leeds

programs.title: Business, Law and Social Studies
programs.summary: Prepare for a degree in one of three engaging subject areas. Develop the knowledge-base you need to succeed at the University of Leeds.

programs.title: Science, Engineering and Computing
programs.summary: Designed as a versatile introduction to these three key subjects, this route allows you to develop all the skills you need for success at the University.

programs.title: Biological Sciences
programs.summary: Open up a wealth of career opportunities across many professional fields. Benefit from exciting modules from across the biological world.

programs.title: Business Management
programs.summary: Gain valuable career-focused skills on this pathway. You'll learn about modern businesses and explore economics, accounting, and entrepreneurship too.

programs.title: Civil Engineering
programs.summary: Develop your understanding of architecture, engineering, structures and materials for progression to a degree at the School of Civil Engineering at the University of Leeds.

programs.title: International Relations and Global Development
programs.summary: Learn about politics, trade, social studies, and modern history on the International Relations pathway.

programs.title: Business
programs.summary: This Pre-Masters Programme will prepare you for a business-related postgraduate degree at the University of Leeds.

description: Located at the heart of the campus, the Leeds University Union has shops, cafés, bars, nightclubs, a theatre, spa, hairdressers, opticians, bank and a student advice centre inside. There are also over 300 clubs and societies for you to get involved with.
